scope: Bounded Openverse discovery followed by original photographer-source checks. This evidence file does not approve any photo, change the app, or modify catalogue data.

discovery.caveat: Openverse metadata is discovery evidence only. A licence label does not establish that an uploader owns underlying manufacturer artwork or establish an exact watch reference.
